summary: Medicus Pharma Ltd. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) announcing a fifty-to-one share consolidation effective October 12, 2026, approved by shareholders at the June 3, 2026 AGM/EGM and effected by the board to lift the bid price and regain Nasdaq Capital Market minimum-bid compliance. Every 50 common shares convert into one new share under new CUSIP 58471K301 and ISIN CA58471K3010; ticker MDCX and name are unchanged, no fractional shares are issued (rounded down with cash in lieu), and rights and voting power are unaltered. This is a routine listing-compliance capital adjustment, not a special situation; watch post-consolidation trading and bid-price compliance over the next several months.
